The Kingpin of Crime.text: Pile grade (Oct, before the sacrifice re-read and today's land fix):

Stadium Headliner.text: 1-drop with mobilize 1; Isshin doubles it, so two attacking 1/1s every attack from turn 2. Fixes the deck's empty 1-slot and feeds the end-step sacrifice payoffs.

Sanguine Syphoner.text: 2-drop; 'whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1' fires twice under Isshin. Cheap early pressure.

Vampire Gourmand.text: 2-drop; on attack sacrifice another creature, draw a card and can't be blocked. Isshin doubles it: sacrifice two mobilize tokens that die at end step anyway, draw two. Fixes thin card draw and fires Vraan, Nightblade, Sothera, Dictate.

Kavaron Harrier.text: 1-drop; pay {2} on attack for a tapped-and-attacking 2/2 Robot. Doubled, but each copy costs {2} — mana-hungry.

Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd.text: 2-drop with flash; on attack exile another nonland permanent until end step. Doubled: can blink two of your ETB creatures, or remove two blockers for the turn.

Seasoned Consultant.text: 2-drop; +2/+0 when you attack with three or more, doubled to +4/+0. Easy to turn on with mobilize.

Anguished Unmaking.text: {1}{W}{B} instant: exile target nonland permanent. The clean answer to a compounding engine the deck lost to.

Ruthless Lawbringer.text: 3-drop creature; ETB sacrifice another creature to destroy target nonland permanent. The sacrifice also fires the death payoffs; a body plus an answer.

Worthy Cost.text: {B}: sacrifice a creature, exile target creature or planeswalker. In main phase 2, sacrifice a mobilize token that would die anyway — 1-mana exile removal that triggers the death payoffs.

Eaten Alive.text: {B}: sacrifice a creature (or pay {3}{B}), exile target creature or planeswalker. Same token line as Worthy Cost, with a fallback cost.

Banishing Light.text: {2}{W}: exile any nonland permanent an opponent controls. Answers enchantments, artifacts and planeswalkers the creature removal can't.

Stormplain Detainment.text: {2}{W}: exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls. A second Banishing Light.

Solitary Cell.text: {R}{W} artifact: exile a nonland permanent with MV 3 or less. Turn-2 answer to an early engine; misses big threats.

Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn.text: 3-drop; 'whenever you cast a legendary spell, draw a card', once each turn. Most of this deck's creatures are legendary, so it draws nearly every turn — the card-advantage fix.

Kor, Cause of Vengeance.text: {1}{R}{W}{B}: whenever you attack, sacrifice another creature to draw a card and give Klingons and Warriors +2/+2. Isshin doubles it: sacrifice two mobilize Warriors (they die at end step anyway) for two cards, and the surviving Warriors get +4/+4. Draw, death-payoff fuel and a pump in one card.

Mardu Ascendancy.text: {R}{W}{B}: whenever a nontoken creature attacks, an attacking 1/1 Goblin. Per attacker AND doubled: three attackers make six tokens, each one fuel for Hellrider/Ingris on the next combat and for the end-step death payoffs.

Adeline, Resplendent Cathar.text: {1}{W}{W}: whenever you attack, an attacking 1/1 Human per opponent; doubled, two a combat and four with an extra combat. Her power is your creature count.

Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon.text: {1}{R}{W}: whenever you attack with a non-Gnome, +1/+1 counter then X attacking Gnomes (X = counters). Doubled, it gains two counters a combat and the token counts climb fast.

Preacher of the Schism.text: {2}{B} deathtouch: attacking the life leader makes a lifelink 1/1; attacking while you lead draws a card. Doubled — two tokens or two cards a turn from a 3-drop.

Merry, Esquire of Rohan.text: {R}{W} haste 2-drop: attack with Merry and another legend, draw a card — doubled, two. Most of this deck's creatures are legendary, so it draws every attack from turn 3.

Gut, True Soul Zealot.text: {2}{R}: whenever you attack, sacrifice another creature or artifact for an attacking 4/1 menace. Doubled: turn two doomed mobilize tokens into two 4/1s, and each sacrifice fires the death payoffs.

Worf, Defiant Commander.text: {2}{R}{W}{B}: a 2/1 haste token on entry; whenever you attack, exile the top card (one opponent) and play it until your next turn. Doubled, two cards of impulse draw every attack.

Rabble Rousing.text: {4}{W}: whenever you attack, a 1/1 per attacker — doubled. Ten creatures casts the hideaway card free. Big on a wide board; 5 mana.

Connecting the Dots.text: {1}{R}, owned: each attacker exiles a card face down, doubled. Later discard your hand and sacrifice it to take them all. A burst-refill engine for a deck that empties its hand.

Marshal of the Lost.text: {2}{W}{B} deathtouch: whenever you attack, a creature gets +X/+X for X attackers — doubled, +2X.

Audacious Thief.text: {2}{B}: draw a card and lose 1 life when it attacks — doubled, two cards. Fragile 2/2.

Moonglove Extractor.text: {2}{B}: same as Audacious Thief (draw on attack, doubled).

Lionheart Glimmer.text: {3}{W}{W} ward 2: whenever you attack, team +1/+1 — doubled, +2/+2.

Path of Bravery.text: {2}{W}: gain life per attacker (doubled) and an anthem while at or above starting life. Lifegain also turns on the drain payoffs' side value.

Boros Charm.text: {R}{W}, owned: permanents you control gain indestructible — the answer to the board wipe that kills a go-wide deck; or 4 to the face.

Selfless Spirit.text: {1}{W} flier: sacrifice it to give your creatures indestructible. The sacrifice also fires the death payoffs.

Adept Watershaper.text: {2}{W} 3/4: other TAPPED creatures you control have indestructible — every attacker survives combat and instant-speed damage while tapped.

The Needs of the Many.text: {1}{W}: sacrifice a creature (a token) for hexproof and indestructible on your team and hexproof on you.

Duty Beyond Death.text: {1}{W}, owned: sacrifice a creature for team indestructible plus a +1/+1 counter each.

Flare of Fortitude.text: Owned: free by sacrificing a nontoken white creature; your life can't change and your permanents gain hexproof and indestructible this turn.

Combat Celebrant.text: {2}{R} 4/1: exert as it attacks to untap your team and add a combat. The exert trigger fires as it attacks, so Isshin may double it — confirm on first play.

Shared Animosity.text: {2}{R}: per attacker +1/+0 for each other attacker sharing a type — doubled. Every mobilize token is a Warrior, as are both Zurgos, Siegebreaker and Face-Breaker.

All-Out Assault.text: {2}{R}{W}{B}: team +1/+1 and deathtouch, and an extra combat if cast in your main phase.

Aggravated Assault.text: {2}{R}: {3}{R}{R} for untap-and-extra-combat, repeatable. Fire Lord Zuko's attack mana can pay for it.

Great Train Heist.text: {R}, owned: spree — untap and extra combat for {2}{R} more, with optional pump and Treasure modes.

Windcrag Siege.text: Owned. Mardu mode is Isshin's own text: 'If a creature attacking causes a triggered ability… to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.' With Isshin out every attack trigger fires THREE times, and it keeps the engine running when Isshin is removed. The single best add in the pile.

Elspeth, Storm Slayer.text: Owned. Doubles every token you create, so mobilize under Isshin makes four tokens per keyword; the 0 pumps and gives flying, the −3 is removal.

Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth,.text: Owned. Enters-or-attacks: sacrifice a creature, draw — doubled on attack. Each other death drains 1; the end-step mobilize sacrifices reach four deaths in a turn, flipping him to a flier that sacrifices any number to draw that many.

Venerated Stormsinger.text: Owned. Mobilize 1 (doubled) plus 'whenever this or another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1' — every doomed token becomes a drain.

Myrel, Shield of Argive.text: Opponents can't cast spells or activate creature/artifact/enchantment abilities during your turn — no instant-speed answers to your attack. Attack trigger makes Soldier tokens equal to your Soldiers; doubled, the second copy counts the first one's tokens.

Winota, Joiner of Forces.text: Owned. Each non-Human attacker (every mobilize Warrior token) looks at six and puts a Human attacking with indestructible — per attacker, doubled. The deck is Human-heavy (Isshin, Raiyuu, Smellerbee, Far Fortune, Combustion Man…).

Ulder Ravengard, Marshal.text: Owned. Attack: conjure a duplicate of another attacking nontoken creature into your hand — two cards every attack under Isshin.

Gilded Ambusher.text: Owned. Attack: sacrifice another nonland permanent (a doomed token) and each opponent exiles a nonland, nontoken permanent — doubled, two exiles per attack. Removal the deck lacked, paid for by tokens.

Witch-king, Bringer of Ruin.text: Attack: defending player sacrifices their weakest creature — doubled, two edicts per attack from a 5/3 flier.

Aurelia, the Law Above.text: Attacking with three or more draws a card (doubled — two); five or more deals 3 to each opponent and gains 3 (doubled — six). Mobilize gets you to five easily.

Skyknight Vanguard.text: {R}{W} flier: attack makes an attacking 1/1 — two under Isshin, from turn 2.

Blade Historian.text: Attacking creatures you control have double strike — doubles all combat damage from a wide token board. Static, so Isshin adds nothing, but it doesn't need to. Hybrid {R/W}x4.

Grave Titan.text: Enters or attacks: two 2/2 Zombies — four per attack under Isshin, on a 6/6 deathtouch.

Avenger of the Fallen.text: Mobilize X = creature cards in your graveyard, doubled. Small early, big late.

Zurgo's Vanguard.text: Owned. Mobilize 1 (doubled); its power equals your creature count.

Dalkovan Outrider.text: Mobilize 2 (doubled) on a 3/4 for 3; its sacrifice clause is a small bonus.

Cruel Administrator.text: Owned. Attack: a permanent 2/2 Soldier with firebending — two per attack, and they stay.

Gideon, the Oathsworn.text: Attacking with two or more puts a +1/+1 counter on each attacker — doubled.

Captain America, Skybound.text: Owned. Battalion: +1/+1 counter on each attacker and indestructible — doubled counters, and your whole attack survives blocks.

Firebender Ascension.text: Owned. Each attack trigger of an attacking creature adds a quest counter (twice under Isshin); at four it copies those triggers — a third multiplier. Plus a 2/2 on entry.

Honored Crop-Captain.text: {R}{W}: attack gives other attackers +1/+0 — +2 under Isshin.

Tori D'Avenant, Fury Rider.text: Attack: others +1/+1, red attackers trample, white attackers untap — doubled pump.

Tsagan, Raider Warlord.text: {R}{W}{B} double strike: attack gives +1/+0 per first/double striker (doubled); max speed (easy with drains) gives others first strike.

Bruse Tarl, Boorish Herder.text: Enters or attacks: a creature gains double strike and lifelink — two creatures per attack under Isshin.

Iroas, God of Victory.text: Your creatures have menace and damage to your attackers is prevented — attacks are free.

Swathcutter Giant.text: Attack: 1 damage to each creature they control — 2 under Isshin, a one-sided sweeper every attack. 6 mana.

Response // Resurgence.text: Response: 5 damage to an attacker or blocker for two hybrid mana. Resurgence: an extra combat.

Seal from Existence.text: Owned. Exile a nonland permanent; ward {3} keeps it there.

Recruit Instructor.text: {R}{W}: attack drafts a spellbook card — two cards per attack from a 2-drop.

Neriv, Crackling Vanguard.text: Flying deathtouch with two Goblins; attack exiles cards per differently named token, playable on turns you attacked with Isshin. Doubled.

The Haunt of Hightower.text: Attack: defender discards (doubled), and it grows from every card they lose. 6 mana.

Alesha, Who Laughs at Fate.text: Owned. Attack counter (doubled) and an end-step reanimation of a creature with MV up to her power.

Olivia, Crimson Bride.text: Owned. Attack: return a creature from your graveyard tapped and attacking — two under Isshin. 6 mana; they leave if Olivia does.

Polterheist.text: Attack: heist the opponent's library — two stolen cards per attack. Ward—pay 3 life.

Bastion of Remembrance.text: Every creature death drains 1; the mobilize end step alone is several a turn.

Waystone's Guidance.text: Owned. Attacking tokens +1/+0, and your first creature spell each turn gains mobilize 1.

Suki, Courageous Rescuer.text: Owned. Team +1/+0, and a permanent leaving on your turn makes a 1/1 Ally (once a turn).

Super Shredder.text: Owned. {1}{B} menace that grows whenever any permanent leaves — every token sacrifice.

Fire Nation Palace.text: Owned. A red land, untapped with a basic out; {1}{R} gives firebending 4, doubled to 8 red mana in combat.

Basri Ket.text: +1 counter and indestructible; the −2's token trigger is a delayed ability, which Isshin does NOT double.

Misty Mountains Raider.text: Owned. Whenever you attack, amass 2 — doubled.

Legion Loyalist.text: 1-drop: battalion gives the team first strike and trample and makes tokens unable to block.

Meddling Youths.text: Owned. Three or more attackers: investigate, doubled.

Shadowfax, Lord of Horses.text: Attack: put a lesser-power creature from hand onto the battlefield attacking, doubled.

Kirk, Commanding Officer.text: Total power 8+: impulse a card on attack, doubled; sacrifice for artifact/enchantment removal.

The Neutrinos.text: Owned. Attack: blink a creature tapped and attacking (re-fires its enters), doubled.

Tenured Inkcaster.text: Each attacker with a +1/+1 counter drains 1, doubled. Needs a counters package.

Gowron, Eager for Battle.text: Owned. Grows on deaths; sacrificing a Klingon draws.

L'Rell, Fierce Visionary.text: Owned. A beginning-of-combat 2/1 token (not doubled) and a surveil sac outlet.

Ankle Shanker.text: Attack: team first strike and deathtouch (doubling adds nothing).

Highway Reaver.text: Enters or attacks: a graveyard creature gains unearth, doubled.

Drana, Liberator of Malakir.text: Combat-damage trigger (not doubled): +1/+1 counters on attackers.

Zhao, Ruthless Admiral.text: Owned. Firebending 2 doubled; sacrifices pump the team +1/+0.

Bontu the Glorified.text: Indestructible menace sac outlet that drains; attacks once something died.

Kardur, Doomscourge.text: Attacking creatures dying drain; forces their creatures into you on entry.

Archangel Elspeth.text: Lifelink 1/1 a turn; −2 makes a flier.

Ares, God of War.text: Owned. Returns dying attackers to hand; tokens just die. Must attack.

Mabel, Heir to Cragflame.text: Owned. Mice payoff; the equipment token is the only part this deck uses.

Improvised Arsenal.text: Owned. Scales with artifacts; the deck has few.

Worf, Honor-Bound Warrior.text: Owned. A 1/1 that doubles its own power on attack.

Uglúk of the White Hand.text: Grows on deaths; Warrior tokens are not Orcs or Goblins.

EPF Point Squad.text: Owned. Grows on creature entries; weaker than Marvel Boy.

Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed.text: Needs {5}{R/P} to transform before it does anything.

Heartless Pillage.text: Owned. Discard two plus a raid Treasure.

Vincent Valentine // Galian Beast.text: Owned. Grows off their creatures dying.

Shredder, Shadow Master.text: Copies only in multiplayer; the half-life hit is combat damage, not doubled.

Velomachus Lorehold.text: Casts instants and sorceries off the top; the deck runs few.

Restless Bivouac.text: Always tapped; the manland is slow.
